ops.body: Root contract review of f078f23: three deviations to correct before integration. (1) Approved pickup preserves Claude session ID; do not silently ModeRekey to a new UUID on an inactive divergent native copy. Keep histories separate and report the collision for explicit selection/fork intent. (2) Normal interactive non-Orca pickup should actually resume native Claude in the recovered worktree as approved, not merely print a second resume command; --json/noninteractive modes can return structured launch details. (3) Avoid a release-by-release TestedVersions whitelist that makes recovery unusable after normal Claude auto-updates. Gate actual incompatible storage/launch capabilities/formats and cover old source transcripts with the supported destination CLI; version-tested means observed fixtures, not automatically rejecting every newer patch absent evidence of incompatibility. If the adapter truly needs exact-version gating for an unportable native rewrite, escalate that concrete limitation instead of silently adding it.
